name: zuehlke-labview-zcode
description: Community ZCode marketplace for the official LabVIEW MCP release. Unofficial - not affiliated with or endorsed by Zuhlke. The plugin zip is fetched directly from the official Zuehlke/labview-mcp GitHub releases (pin: v3.1.6, sha256-verified); this repository only carries the marketplace listing.

plugins.name: labview-mcp
plugins.description: Read, write and run LabVIEW 2026 code from an AI assistant - VIs as text via AIXML, palette and shipping-example search, Caraya unit tests, DQMH modules and events, and eight bundled LabVIEW agents. Windows x64 only. The zip is fetched from the official Zuehlke/labview-mcp releases.

author.name: Zuhlke Engineering AG (upstream); marketplace maintained by SeveNOlogy7
